info.name: MagicMatch by LiquiDonate Donate Ship API
Match items to a nonprofit and buy the donation label

items.docs: Matches the supplied items to a nearby nonprofit and purchases a shipping label in one call. Use for standard parcel-shippable items only - furniture, mattresses, drug paraphernalia, items over 50 kg and items returned as Damaged are excluded; route those to v1/donate. Pass `match_uuid` from v1/matchAndShip/estimate to lock in the previewed match and rate.

info.name: Attach your own shipping labels to a match

items.docs: Updates an existing match with labels you purchased yourself. Required after v1/match when you generate your own postage, so the receiving nonprofit is notified and donation receipts can be issued.

info.name: Buy a shipping label between two fixed addresses

items.docs: Creates a shipment from a known source address to a known destination address. Performs no nonprofit matching and generates no donation receipts. Use for warehouse, fulfillment-center or store-originated returns where the destination is already fixed. Do not combine with v1/match - they are separate workflows.
